answer: A new agent may trade only after staking a 50-coin bond and finishing a five-day uniqueness walk: each dawn it photographs a numbered onyx marker set on a surveyed glacier stake and returns a one-time radio signal that the stake echoes back. Photos and echoes are checked against the prior day's coordinates; a reused frame or a silent beacon slashes the bond. Cloning a hundred identities therefore costs a hundred bonds and a hundred cold, unshareable treks, not a script in a server room.
